groups.contract: Interior light grid must preserve native address, dimensions, room and interpolation aggregate
groups.disposition: Seven complete exact shader bodies personally read; no shader check/compile/GPU/render/art verification. Interior buildings fixedarray16 but countx unchecked in shader; sample address=offset+(cell.y*dims.z+cell.z)*dims.x+cell.x requires host allocated products/offsets representableu32 and every building metadata matches sample buffer. Position divides by horizontal cell and storeyheight; boundary checks precede floor/cast only for valid finite dimensions/local frame. Reserved countsy must remain0: width2+i32(countsy) changes both work and bilinear weight meaning if raw host violates reservedzero. Normalized interpolation selects center for missing/different-room neighbors, preventing deliberate cross-partition spill for admitted room metadata. Actual first-party grid producer and transformednormal/frame admissibility remain dependencies; no concrete count>16, zeroheight or actual wrong room value published. Fixed reference floor1e-4 bounds final occlusion denominator but not arbitrary nonfinite light product.

groups.contract: Pebble mesh and billboard paths have different encoded geometry and native normal prerequisites
groups.disposition: Mesh uses actual transformed normal and native bounded light iteration; billboard deliberately treats vertex.normal as pebble center rather than a normal, then camera-facing basis reconstructs silhouette/lighting. Exact producer attribute contract must preserve this semantic distinction, not a blanket normal-owner reuse. Derivative floors bound reciprocal diameter and silhouette width; sqrtmax prevents negative sphere remainder, but signed vector+epsilon normalization can still cancel and needs actual camera/geometry admission. Pixel threshold/hash and material/exposure raw native ports do not prove finite outputs. No actor/camera degenerate case or visual disagreement promoted; ordinary light/shadow/transmission policies remain as source.

groups.contract: Instanced shrub normals assume admitted batch frame in addition to per-instance yaw
groups.disposition: Positions use native complete instance_matrix from batch world_from_local plus per-instance scale/yaw. Normal paths only apply per-instance yaw and normalize, explicitly assuming uniform scale and omitting batch linear orientation. If actual supported batch carries nonidentity rotation/nonuniform scale, normals could disagree with rendered geometry; no such actual CPU batch supplier/witness inspected yet, so qualified source-derived candidate only. Leaf wind normalization/displacement require nonzero direction and finite amplitudes; derivativeGrad backface texture path preserves intentional divergent-face sampling. Packed wood vertex color carries metric root-height data, while shrub bark deliberately uses flat pigment; keep producer/recipient semantics. Complementary dither is same represented16step policy as284, not a new duplicate finding. Unused bound front/backnormal textures are no arithmetic/mutation defect and do not authorize cleanup in discovery.

groups.contract: Moon/star radiance and view expansion require admitted astronomy/material/viewport values
groups.disposition: Moon phase/scattering divides by max(positive sum,.025), lunar albedo normalization uses fixed.18 and bounded posterization; finite unit normal/light/view directions remain native mesh/astronomy producer dependencies. Star quad expands clip coordinates by native viewport extents and clipw; nonzero active viewport, finite dome distance and actual magnitude/radiance owner needed. pow10(-.4*magnitude) can overflow for arbitrary huge negative finite raw magnitude, but no catalog/first-party ordinary negative-extreme star asserted. Sky transform/clock source authority and valid formed celestial directions are independent actual source roles, not cleared by shader reading. Preserve real calendar/astronomy coordinate conventions and intentional horizon/visibility thresholds.
